q1.q: How much does a solar system cost?
q1.a: It depends on the size you need, which depends on your bill and roof. Use Find My Solar Plan or the calculator for an estimate. We give you one clear quote once we know your roof and needs.

q2.q: Can I get a government subsidy?
q2.a: Homes can get a subsidy as per current government scheme. The amount depends on current rules and system size. We confirm what you qualify for and do the paperwork.

q3.q: How long until it pays for itself?
q3.a: Most systems earn back their cost in a few years through lower bills. Your exact payback depends on your bill, system size and subsidy. The calculator shows an estimate.

q4.q: Does solar work on cloudy or rainy days?
q4.a: Yes, but it makes less power. We size your system on yearly averages, so sunny months make up for cloudy ones. At night, you use grid power as usual.

q5.a: Very little. Clean the panels with water every few weeks and get a yearly check. We offer maintenance (AMC) and cleaning plans if you prefer.

q6.a: Yes. Many banks offer solar loans. We guide you through the options and the paperwork. See the Subsidy & Loans page for an EMI estimate.

q7.a: A two-way meter counts the power you use and the extra power you send to the grid. You pay only for the difference. We apply for it with your Telangana DISCOM.

q8.a: Panels and inverters come with manufacturer warranties. We also give an installation warranty and after-sales service. We share all warranty papers at handover.

Telangana Solar was created with a simple vision: to make clean, affordable solar energy accessible to every home, farm, and business across Telangana.

We help people understand solar solutions, explore government subsidies, and choose the right solar system based on their needs. Our goal is to make the journey to solar energy simple, transparent, and hassle-free.

Our promise is simple — helping Telangana save more with clean energy.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Telangana Solar collects through this website and how we use it. [EDIT] Have this reviewed by your legal adviser.

s1.p: When you fill a form or use the calculator report, we collect your name, mobile number, location, type of property, electricity bill, preferred visit time, and calculator results. We also record which page you used and when.

s2.p: We use your details to contact you about your enquiry, prepare your solar plan and quotes, and send you messages on WhatsApp, SMS or phone about your request.

s3.p: We use Google Analytics, Meta Pixel and Google Ads to understand how the website is used and to measure our advertising. These services may use cookies.

s4.p: We do not sell your data. We share it only with service providers who help us run our business (for example messaging, email and storage providers), and when required by law.

s5.p: You can ask us to see, correct or delete your data, or to stop contacting you, at any time using the contact details below.

s6.p: For privacy questions, contact us using the details on our Contact page. [EDIT] Add your registered business name and address.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using this website you agree to these terms. [EDIT] Have this reviewed by your legal adviser.

s1.p: Content on this website, including calculator results, prices and subsidy information, is for general guidance. All figures are estimates. The final design and price depend on your site and system.

s2.p: Subsidy amounts and eligibility depend on current government rules, which can change. We help you apply but do not guarantee approval or amount.

s3.p: A written quote from us, accepted by you, forms the agreement for any installation. Website content does not form an offer.

s4.p: Equipment warranties are provided by manufacturers. Our installation warranty terms are given in writing with your quote.

s5.p: We are not responsible for decisions made only on the basis of website estimates.

s6.p: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts in Hyderabad, Telangana have jurisdiction. [EDIT]

what.title: What is solar?
what.desc: Panels on your roof turn sunlight into electricity. An inverter makes it safe for your home. No fuel, no noise.

cut.title: How does it cut your bill?
cut.desc: In the day, your home uses solar power first. Extra power goes to the grid through a net meter, and those units are reduced from your bill.

inverter.title: Inverter
inverter.desc: Makes it safe for home use

ongrid.name: On-grid
ongrid.desc: Connected to the grid with a net meter. No battery. Lowest cost and fastest payback.
ongrid.best: Homes and businesses with steady power

offgrid.name: Off-grid
offgrid.desc: Works without the grid, using batteries. Costs more and needs battery care.

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.desc: Grid-connected with a battery for backup. Keeps essentials running during power cuts.
hybrid.best: Areas with frequent cuts, hospitals, critical loads
